| | | U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) has **investigated hundreds of nonprofits across the U.S. that help people register to vote** over the last year, according to internal government documents. Homeland Security Investigations, ICE’s investigative arm, **also contemplated sending undercover agents to investigate the organizations**. These investigations into voting rights groups were part of the Department of Homeland Security’s (DHS) extensive, expensive, taxpayer-funded work to support repeated lies about illegal voting by noncitizens. **For years, opponents of voting rights have used claims of noncitizens voting to call into question election results and push for stricter voting laws.** In truth, noncitizen voting is exceptionally rare, and there is no credible evidence from public and private investigations from both ends of our political spectrum that noncitizen voting has swayed an election. **This is about power, plain and simple.** Opponents of voting rights are going to use every tool they can think of to limit voters casting legitimate votes, including investigating groups like ours that just want to help eligible citizens register. **[Our work to defend our fundamental right to vote won't stop, ICE or no ICE. Peter,
**We have a real chance to send one of California’s best and brightest to Washington in 26 days: Scott Wiener in California’s 11th Congressional District.**
[](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21531?c0=em_ms_ttp_20261008_1_ak._QGNSZ&refcode=em20261008-41600&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=41600%2E3422442%2ESRrTje)
Scott is a proven champion for working families, which is why I’m proud to endorse his campaign. Before I explain more, **[can you split a donation between Scott and Truth to Power today?](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21531?c0=em_ms_ttp_20261008_1_ak._QGNSZ&refcode=em20261008-41600&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=41600%2E3422442%2ESRrTje)**

Here’s why Scott’s voice is so important right now.
* **Tackling the Housing Crisis:** Across the country, people are feeling the pressure of skyrocketing housing costs. Scott has led on housing reform for years and is ready to bring that experience to Congress to fight for real solutions that address homelessness and keep young people from being priced out of their communities.
* **Standing Up to Big Tech:** The rise of AI is centered right here in California, and it could reshape so much of our lives. Scott is clear-eyed about what is at stake, and he will make sure it’s everyday people, not CEOs, who get put first. He’s ready to stand up for working families and pass common-sense AI regulations that protect the public.
* **Fighting Climate Change:** Scott is ready to lead the charge on environmental action. He is running to restore our clean energy investments, protect public lands by stopping new fossil fuel drilling, and end the billions in subsidies we give to big polluters.

Washington needs more bold leaders ready to fight for progressive values, and _that is exactly the type of congressman Scott will be._
With just under four weeks left, every extra resource matters in this race. I know support from this grassroots team would go a long way in ensuring Scott can reach voters across the district.
**[Peter, can you split a donation of $5 or more between Scott’s campaign and Truth to Power to send a champion for working Californians to Congress?](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21531?c0=em_ms_ttp_20261008_1_ak._QGNSZ&refcode=em20261008-41600&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=5&akid=41600%2E3422442%2ESRrTje)**

Katie Porter

subject: Nobody in my family asked what they'd get.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Michael Bouchard, Inc
body:
Three generations, all inside this district.
I grew up watching two men go to work.
| | | FRIENDS OF MICHAEL BOUCHARD MICHIGAN'S 10TH DISTRICT
---
[](http://links.mikebouchardforcongress.com/u/click?_t=bb25c0b583c5471786d790f5e4203cc0&_m=dd67ee29bd1f4f25b0e7b8ca1e28287c&_e=B7m-vevVjU3mXceB0KeehSP0DtA5BhPLLC9bhkAatWY9s5dgKtNMT7r_bJz-YvHGSHn0Ct-pLTthz4JIluTu2VilparnwzH6eOEGjM61Ek3U8R-YZUCfEaHJL-jyxVlkKoGycyruBX_w9zvu39iOTTKCHDQexiUrZ1Q_qLmeKK4p87GbLN5vBQgFnCneA_Nxaa5Qkqe_Y5cMX2RHUhcafArozcphQNTVHdMCxfVNW7kPu_k-A7jVth3QhMh1_Mqwd_Al2xN7mlUZJZ0587LLy3yN7rUbKYXx5PUy49YjLZ7GsZNSxSCZUUAehFUfmt2JhzlludTv4k79vu66-m8Tx4Le6DQDj2Ul-BeACK5Z2hVp-Os5Ops674KQ0iwu7JOEZ7N2xhlYjQu2wcn6F49VbTga6cEg0trAV2Pk3Yo8LenPFgIhK9ZjlwIWkhToUWTKVLjVTMyNS4nsQNqG2BRplw%3D%3D)

Peter,
---
I grew up watching two men go to work.
---
| 33 YEARS GM plant, Warren | 38 YEARS Oakland County badge
---|---
My grandfather came home from the war and walked into the General Motors plant in Warren. He stayed thirty-three years. That plant built what won a world war -- the Arsenal of Democracy, they called it -- and he was proud of it every single day of those thirty-three years.
---
My father pinned on a badge in Oakland County. He's still wearing it, thirty-eight years later. I grew up with a phone that rang at three in the morning and a dad who got up and went.
---
Neither of them ever asked what this country could do for them. They asked where they were needed, and then they went there.
---
That's about the only lesson my family ever really taught me, and it's why I took a commission out of ROTC instead of doing what most of my classmates were doing.
---
I spent nearly ten years in the Army -- the 82nd Airborne, then the 101st. Last year I volunteered to deploy to Iraq on twenty days' notice.
---
I'll be honest with you, I could have said no to that one. Nobody would have thought less of me for it. But I kept hearing my grandfather in the back of my head asking where I was needed.
---
**I never wanted a desk job in Washington.
[](http://links.mikebouchardforcongress.com/u/click?_t=bb25c0b583c5471786d790f5e4203cc0&_m=dd67ee29bd1f4f25b0e7b8ca1e28287c&_e=B7m-vevVjU3mXceB0KeehSP0DtA5BhPLLC9bhkAatWY9s5dgKtNMT7r_bJz-YvHGSHn0Ct-pLTthz4JIluTu2VilparnwzH6eOEGjM61Ek3U8R-YZUCfEaHJL-jyxVlkzcF0t28sYHGt7zZp9mLTHy2Ofw_w2XAcpQtyz7C-FnkGCbE4etRFQ_tnMHo3GlBWbrBGMUJy8gp9BFOok_hxPXZkthQn4REnoS2VJWCMxn5RYBLz6VYKWVzD_8ziiVW2IT3vhxcPCBkps0QIdT9iTRI3_tainKg5123qQVmrcg8zn2lm0rE9VTXoo-A0cEvitXFbgNjiXl0tykwtnh0v-zDO5KsXhFNINKLEGe0r5o-g5RP7vfUPJ1CErnPUq0mUKim2V-_ZOIf1hnSw5nGSJrUmzni1yW8YZcX1MtRFIqJ5-wmZmdJ4Scz7o86_IaenlG0ymreyxcxVEdD5EjMDTw%3D%3D)
**
---
I still don't. I'm not running because I've always dreamed of being a congressman. I'm running because I came home, looked at who's making the decisions in that building, and couldn't find enough people who have ever been sent anywhere.
---
Veteran representation in Congress is at a **record low**. I'd like to do something about that.
---
If you want a Congress with more people in it who know what a mission is and finish it, I'd be grateful for your help today.
---
[**ELECT A COMBAT VETERAN >>**](http://links.mikebouchardforcongress.com/u/click?_t=bb25c0b583c5471786d790f5e4203cc0&_m=dd67ee29bd1f4f25b0e7b8ca1e28287c&_e=B7m-vevVjU3mXceB0KeehSP0DtA5BhPLLC9bhkAatWY9s5dgKtNMT7r_bJz-YvHGSHn0Ct-pLTthz4JIluTu2VilparnwzH6eOEGjM61Ek3U8R-YZUCfEaHJL-jyxVlk6iFYVEPVYKhj1size9gCW5ab9jKy0gB1FX6-REURMIrJ1JRq1Hyx0RPSsdxmcLYPapttfc2YeBuJzHava-FrXd8kv4r123uAQOyaaSoTBz8V8bmhXiuKdjeAlTpAkLC6qhh83zpjCiSSgmvvzxef735_ZLxuMc48iveiSZXRYFnLLGqIgjLm7doxe1Yx7vokqac9K-mbSFupnz-tYZnRxP-ZO4DvIc1o7Ukn-6b26d2mclBOVLAuCJhAD8PDoga70yR8HDEjz0r3DIIUYjk5m9CoBzs6gKW_htrUx8OweL1eOazYiaka4T3SvBgkZFYjuGuOEpBiUGkCW4maC-fAAg%3D%3D)
---
I'm not a politician, and I don't expect I'll ever be very good at the parts of this that politicians are good at.
---
But I know how to show up and I know how to finish something. My family made sure of that.
---
[**STAND WITH MIKE >>**](http://links.mikebouchardforcongress.com/u/click?_t=bb25c0b583c5471786d790f5e4203cc0&_m=dd67ee29bd1f4f25b0e7b8ca1e28287c&_e=B7m-vevVjU3mXceB0KeehSP0DtA5BhPLLC9bhkAatWY9s5dgKtNMT7r_bJz-YvHGSHn0Ct-pLTthz4JIluTu2VilparnwzH6eOEGjM61Ek3U8R-YZUCfEaHJL-jyxVlkutjCN0xKrTYBdLzz3auBVhrGYaLONxqkZoUAM7YdBhdDABcIyqkajva0726b77xnVh631gkpmHtPA2I97-ZrJzIuZdCv007-aqfJ9mdYnGAvr0VQreJYjAB7bfLHCmnynRyj4WcfE5rvJx6EFMHwlGWVG9QPvsE0jZdOumfkeDIANWSr3eALftkd1A56iS1hxvGm8RzP2ywDVG1aXI1FPosQOm174GaDVrfI6B2YYoUtpXveUOZW6AiqVyGL0ZJ9vKt83u3OiVKDbCIOhhJlZZA5umuzt5fRmuITFnB-_6ZOBscqRtxlZlReypPlA_OH8kINJfUdAKdPh3hByTF1-w%3D%3D)
---
Duty First,
---
**Captain Mike Bouchard**
---
Army Paratrooper | Bronze Star Recipient

In 1998, Coach Tuberville was announced as the next head coach for the Auburn Tigers. Tuberville's time at Auburn was a success by any measure, as the Tigers captured eight consecutive bowl appearances, including five New Year's Day bowl appearances, five SEC Western Division titles, one SEC Championship, and a 13-0 season in 2004, after which Coach Tuberville was once again named the AP's SEC Coach of the Year. For his efforts during the perfect 2004 season, Tuberville would be named Paul "Bear" Bryant Coach of the Year, Associated Press Coach of the Year, Walter Camp Coach of the Year, Sporting News Coach of the Year, and AFCA Coach of the Year, among others. In 2020, Coach Tuberville became Senator Tuberville, winning his election to represent all Alabamians in the United States Senate with the full support of President Trump. Since then, he's supported President Trump's America-First policies while fighting off the Radical Left. In his first term as Senator, Tommy was one of eight Republicans to vote against certifying the 2020 election, has been a strong pro-life advocate, and called out Democrats for being pro-crime. Now, Coach Tuberville is running for Governor so he can continue representing Alabamians and Americans in his homestate of Alabama. The Radical Left thinks they can flip Alabama blue and turn it into the California of the South. Can he count on your support? subject: [Ground Truth Report] This is now a truly nationwide program

body:
#
Hi there,
Today, we’re excited to share a deep dive into all of our Ground Truth learnings from the third quarter of 2026.
**Here’s the short version: Ground Truth is now a truly nationwide battleground program.**
By the end of Q3, Ground Truth had expanded into 58 of the country's most competitive races. _That’s 49 House races and 9 Senate races across 23 states!_
Through the end of Q3, Ground Truth volunteers have:
* Held more than 853 canvasses
* Launched more than 476 phone banks
* Had more than 41,000 conversations with voters

Our goal over the next few weeks is to have thousands more conversations with the voters who will help decide the balance of power in Washington and in states across the country, and we can’t get there without you.
**If you’d like to sign up for a Ground Truth shift ahead of Election Day,[click here to find the best action for you.](https://act.swingleft.org/go/2616?t=1&akid=3067%2E1562180%2EtJxPgP)**
**Alternatively, you can[make a donation of any amount at this link](https://act.swingleft.org/go/2617?t=2&akid=3067%2E1562180%2EtJxPgP) to support the work this community is doing.**
**The Shift to Persuasion**
In September, we did something we’d been planning since the start of the program. Before, our conversations at the doors focused mainly on listening, but we’ve now expanded the Ground Truth script to make the case for Democratic candidates directly.
Now volunteers are asking voters to rate their support for the Democratic candidate at the start of the conversation, and again at the end. That being said, the foundation of these conversations is still listening because that’s what enables a volunteer to connect what voters care about to what the candidate has done and will do.
**By the end of the third quarter of 2026, we’ve seen an early signal this program is working: when voters' support shifted during a Ground Truth conversation, it shifted toward the Democrat about 9 out of 10 times.**
Take a look at a few of the voters that volunteers have been in conversation with:
**What Voters Are Talking About**
Volunteer canvassers with Ground Truth aren’t bringing a checklist of issues to the door. They’re asking open-ended questions and writing down what each voter says, and we make these notes available to campaigns on a new dashboard.
Here’s a chart that shows how often each topic has come up, as a share of all conversations, by month. It isn’t a poll, and it isn’t designed to be representative, but it does give us a sense of how the public mood and attention shift over time:
As in previous quarters, trust in the system and the cost of living came up most often. But as the election loomed closer over the course of Q3, the share of conversations that mention the cost of living rose. The two issues often come up together: of voters who raised either the system being broken or affordability, about a third raised both. Conversations about immigration and the border became less common over the quarter.
**The Volunteer Experience**
This quarter, the number of volunteers participating in Ground Truth grew by nearly 50%. And together, we completed 2,501 Ground Truth shifts, up from 1,720 in Q2.
September was our busiest month yet, with 916 volunteers completing 1,086 shifts. And 400 of those volunteers came back for more than one shift during the quarter!
Here’s what a few volunteers had to say about Ground Truth, in their own words:
_"As the mother of five children, I have learned the power of listening FIRST, giving them the chance to say what matters to them, and then engaging with them where they are rather than where I want them to be... I believe that Ground Truth's approach to deep listening is a way to find common ground."_
— Dawne, First-Time Canvasser in AZ-01
_“This country needs to come together, and I think by listening and understanding we are moving forward with repairing the damage of us vs. them."_
—Lisa, Experienced Canvasser in CA-48
**What Comes Next**
Thanks to the entire Swing Left community, Ground Truth is helping Democrats rebuild trust and invest in voter contact built to not only win votes this year, but to strengthen our ability to organize for the elections ahead.
With Election Day less than four weeks away, there are two ways you can take action today to help maximize the number of conversations we can collectively have with voters:
* **[Sign up for a Ground Truth shift!](https://act.swingleft.org/go/2616?t=3&akid=3067%2E1562180%2EtJxPgP) Our Take Action Tool will help you find the best volunteer opportunity for you, based on your location and comfort level.**

* **[Make a donation to support Ground Truth!](https://act.swingleft.org/go/2617?t=4&akid=3067%2E1562180%2EtJxPgP) A program of this scale takes an enormous amount of resources to pull off, and grassroots donations are a big part of what powers our work.**

Thank you again for being a part of this work—we truly couldn’t do it without you.
— The Swing Left Team
_P.S. — Want to download the full report?[**Click here.**](https://act.swingleft.org/go/2589?t=5&akid=3067%2E1562180%2EtJxPgP)_

**Since 2017, Swing Left has channeled the energy of grassroots volunteers and donors to elect Democrats, up and down the ballot, focusing on the most competitive races that can swing the national balance of power.** Right now, Swing Left is investing in grassroots organizing in key swing districts and initiatives across the country to flip the House and win the Senate and critical states in 2026. [**If you’d like to help support our work, you can make a donation using this link.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_sl_footer?refcode=em20261008-3&t=6&refcode2=3067_1562180_tJxPgP&akid=3067%2E1562180%2EtJxPgP)

clean_body: We’ll need your grassroots support to help elect Democracy Defenders in Ohio and beyond. | Peter, We need to talk about what’s at stake in Ohio in the next few weeks, and why your = Over the last decade, Ohio Republicans have shamelessly sidestepped voter-approved redistricting reforms and even court orders to impose some of the worst gerrymanders in the country. At every turn, no matter what the people of Ohio want, the GOP has schemed tirelessly to undermine reform. Case in point: In 2024, voters gathered enough signatures to place a constitutional amendment on the ballot that would create an independent, citizen-led redistricting commission to fix the map manipulation problem. But Republican politicians and outside interests spent a fortune sabotaging the measure. They ensured the ballot language was so deceptive that the proposed anti-gerrymandering amendment sounded like it was pro-gerrymandering. Early voting started this week in the Buckeye State, and voters will get the opportunity to elect three Democracy Defenders to key statewide offices: Amy Acton for governor, Allison Russo for secretary of state, Annette Blackwell for auditor, and Justice Jennifer Brunner for state supreme court. The National Democratic Redistricting Committee is working to make sure the Republicans who've done everything in their power to rig the rules in their favor finally get benched — in Ohio and nationwide. Don’t give up the ship!
# [](https://act.chrisforpa.com/go/46?t=1&akid=119%2E42639%2EbPWM6i)
A year into the War of 1812, Captain James Lawrence led a ship out to sea from Boston to fight the British.
He got gunned down, and his dying command to his sailors was "Don't Give Up the Ship!"
Commodore Perry learned about his friend's dying words, assembled a squadron of ships and kicked the British butts in the Battle of Lake Erie, and turned the tide of the war.
On his flagship that day was a battle flag with the words, "Don't Give Up the Ship," that became a rallying cry for a young nation unsure if it would even continue to exist.
Today, some may feel like the country is on its heels. Maybe you feel a sense of despair or hopelessness.
That is the exact moment we have to say "Don't give up the ship!"
I'm running for re-election because patriotism demands courage in this moment. The courage to fight the corruption and abuses of the Trump administration. The courage to fight the concentrated corporate power responsible for holding back the American Dream from too many people.
**[Please watch and share.](https://act.chrisforpa.com/go/170?t=2&akid=119%2E42639%2EbPWM6i)**

Don’t give up the ship,
Chris Deluzio

Peter, I’ve been out on the road meeting with North Carolinians directly, and I’ll tell you: **Folks are fired up to flip this seat.**
The voters I talk with are fed up with the chaos in Washington DC. They’re struggling to afford quality health care. They can’t keep up with soaring gas prices and grocery bills. They’re ready for a U.S. Senator – and a federal government – that makes life easier for folks, not harder.
That’s why I’m in this fight, but I need your help.
You see, while I’ve been on the campaign trail talking with and listening to voters, the GOP has poured millions into this race to try to buy this seat for my opponent, Michael Whatley. **They’ve blasted the airwaves with false attack ads against me, and if we’re not able to respond, we could put our chances at flipping North Carolina at serious risk.**
Republicans think this seat is for sale – but first, they’re going to have to get through this grassroots team, Peter. Early voting.
#
Early voting in some states has already started, Peter.
Voters in key battleground states like Arizona — along with critical House districts in Virginia, California, and New Mexico — are already casting their ballots.
We're in the thick of get out the vote season, and what we do right now in this home stretch will not only shape who takes power in January 2027, but also set the groundwork for 2028, 2030, and beyond.

Solidarity Sunday Brunch Fundraiser with Darryl Block
Solidarity Sunday is about more than sending Darryl Block to the Florida House. It is about coming together, standing up for our communities, and building a grassroots movement for change.

* Sunday, October 11th at 1:30 PM
* Register for Location

Darryl is a husband, father, attorney, certified mediator, and former social worker who believes government should work for the people it represents. His campaign is focused on affordability, healthcare, public education, responsible growth, protecting our natural lands, and standing up for Florida families.
Join us for an afternoon of music, wine, tapas, and good company as we gather in solidarity with Darryl and his campaign for Florida House District 36.
Your support helps build a grassroots campaign that can reach voters, share Darryl's vision, and bring more people into the democratic process.
Come raise a glass, connect with fellow supporters, and be part of the conversation about Florida's future!

U.S. Sen. Susan Collins (R) squared off against Graham Platner's replacement as Maine's Democratic Senate nominee, Troy Jackson, in the second of four scheduled debates in a contest that could determine the balance of partisan power in Washington, D.C., for the final two years of President Donald Trump's second term.
Jackson defended Democratic health insurance mandates that have driven Maine's ACA benchmark premiums 77% higher than those in neighboring New Hampshire.
Costly health insurance was only one area where U.S. Sen. Susan Collins' comparisons to New Hampshire left Jackson grasping to explain how Collins' record in Congress has driven the cost of living in Maine more than Jackson's six-year tenure as the most powerful Democratic lawmaker in a state totally controlled by Democrats.
Unlike government-run health care and solar taxes, subscribing to The Robinson Report will not make your life worse.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..VJHBCSja4elxIeM6hCKbtjdMVLC0Ouj8wbqoO_b_kUY?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=219524688)
Asked why Maine's electricity rates are the fourth-highest in the nation while the Granite State enjoys far cheaper power, Jackson struggled to explain why Democrats failed to repeal the Solar Tax, sometimes called Net Energy Billing, despite warnings from the state's public advocate that the policy would send electricity rates skyrocketing by hundreds of millions of dollars each year.
When Collins turned to the cost of insurance across the state line, Jackson did not dispute her number. He defended Maine's coverage mandates and suggested Collins preferred inferior insurance.
"I'm sure Senator Collins would like us to have junk insurance programs," Jackson said, continuing:
> "But no, we thought it was more important to make sure that people did have prescription drugs, pharmaceutical care, all these different things, and that, I think, is what real health insurance should be--not stuff that people go to and still come out of there having to spend, spend a lot of money to get the care they need."
Collins immediately challenged the premise.
"Junk insurance programs are not what we're talking about here," she said. Her comparison concerned Affordable Care Act plans (aka ObamaCare), which carry mandatory benefits.
The price gap is supported by [KFF's 2026 figures](https://substack.com/redirect/0e5b646d-ccfc-482c-85ef-4dd2cd74bdff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg): Maine's average monthly benchmark premium is $709, compared with $401 in New Hampshire. That is a $308 monthly difference, or about 77%, before subsidies.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..VJHBCSja4elxIeM6hCKbtjdMVLC0Ouj8wbqoO_b_kUY?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=219524688)
New Hampshire's marketplace plans must cover prescription drugs, hospitalization and other [essential health benefits](https://substack.com/redirect/479c6324-9140-46f6-a95b-c9f9bf6a1d96?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), just as Maine's must. However, there are variations among plan types and coverage levels, and there are instances, such as abortion coverage mandates, where Maine's mandates for private insurance are more extensive.
Collins used New Hampshire to similar effect on electricity, challenging Jackson's effort to put Maine's high bills at the feet of the Iran war.
> "If it were the Iran war, why wouldn't New Hampshire and other states have the same level of electric bills that Maine has?" Collins asked.
Moderator Jon Chrisos pressed Jackson on his support for the 2019 expansion of net energy billing, a Solar Tax that's collected by energy utilities and passed along to solar developers, 88% of which are located outside the state of Maine. The moderators cited the public advocate's estimate that the solar program would cost electricity customers more than $234 million in 2025.
Jackson said lawmakers had twice reformed the program and argued that wars and fossil fuel prices were driving energy costs, as opposed to the solar taxes that Maine's top ratepayer advocate has concluded are driving up Maine's energy costs.
"It did cost more than it should have, but we reformed it twice," he said.
Collins accused him of opposing legislation that would have saved the average household $275 a year. Jackson disputed her account and returned to Trump and Iran, arguing that the war was costing Mainers far more. He also defended plans to bring wind power south from Aroostook County.
Jackson's attempted wind power project in Aroostook County never caught flight, but if it had, the primary beneficiaries would have been foreign investors. An [investigation](https://substack.com/redirect/c61ce3aa-c1e8-48ae-b03a-79645d2bb184?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by The Maine Wire found that Longroad Energy, the Boston-based developer that was supposed to manage the wind farm, is 92 percent owned by large foreign investment funds, including one controlled by a foreign government.

The exchanges forced Jackson to defend decisions he helped make in Augusta during a debate he repeatedly tried to turn toward Washington, Trump, and Iran.
His state campaign finance records also complicated his opening attack on Collins over corruption.
Chrisos asked Jackson how his rejection of corporate PAC money in the Senate race squared with his earlier leadership of a state political action committee that accepted money from tobacco, pharmaceutical and gambling interests.
Jackson said the organization made decisions collectively. He denied that contributions bought legislation or contracts and said he had stopped pharmaceutical contributions. State campaign finance records show that corporations donated heavily to the Maine Senate Democratic Campaign Committee, which Jackson led as the Senate President.

Collins challenged his effort to distance himself from the committee, then turned to his son.
> "And if you look at the number of times that Troy has flip-flopped his position on issues, it usually has to do with issues that his son has been hired to lobby him on," she said.
Jackson invoked independent fact-checkers and rejected the allegation.
> "There's nothing there, but Senator Collins would like to confuse the voters because she is in a system where she's taking money from corporations almost daily to make sure that they get the contracts they want," he said.
That was the second time that Jackson has evaded directly addressing a pattern of legislative successes for clients of Resurgam Group, the lobbying firm run by his former chief of staff B.J. McCollister and his son, Chace Jackson.
In the first debate, moderator Gregg Lagerquist asked Jackson directly about payments to his son's lobbying firm influencing his legislative decisions. Jackson responded by insisting that his son had done nothing wrong without denying that payments to Resurgam Group coincided with legislative victories or even changes in Jackson's position.
In perhaps the most glaring case of a Jackson family pay-to-play scheme, the Maine Gun Safety Coalition began a contract with Chace Jackson as the primary lobbyist in December 2023. Less than one month later, Troy Jackson had changed positions he'd held on gun control issues for more than 20 years.

But that's just one of the examples where Resurgam clients appear to have benefited from the Jackson family machine.
Covenant Health, parent of St. Mary's in Lewiston, listed Chace as principal lobbyist in 2024 and reported $24,000 in compensation. Jackson helped enact a budget that put $8.5 million toward sustaining and expanding acute behavioral-health services at St. Mary's.
Jackson cosponsored the 2023 offshore-wind law, [LD 1895](https://substack.com/redirect/a87f6864-81b1-4c35-bff5-c54de2bbca5a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), which set a 3,000-megawatt target by 2040 with labor standards. The Maine Labor Climate Council's director has publicly lauded Resurgam's influence over the legislation, which would cause Maine's already high electricity prices to soar even further--if it ever succeeds.
Jackson has yet to effectively rebut or even deny that pattern of favoritism shown to Resurgam clients while he was Senate President, even as he accuses Collins of selling access to her office based on a now-debunked story published by the left-wing outlet ProPublica.
In a story that seemed timed to influence Maine's pivotal U.S. Senate race, the left-wing outlet described a cloak-and-dagger plot in which defense contractor executive Martin Kao secured a meeting with Collins and extracted promises for massive defense spending after making illegal campaign contributions.
In a press conference earlier this week, [Collins' campaign presented a funding chronology and a photograph](https://substack.com/redirect/45d9b9be-a0a6-4734-a27a-fb27754be399?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) debunking the ProPublica theory, which rested entirely on Kao's own account.
Kao [pleaded guilty in 2022](https://substack.com/redirect/54469003-b98f-4305-9eab-d206a0d98f48?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to offenses involving unlawful campaign contributions and false information supplied to the Federal Election Commission, but his track record of fraud and seemingly pathological lying has been well documented.
Jackson's effort to make ethics the defining issue of the race also comes with the unresolved controversy over his [FHA-insured mortgage on an Augusta house](https://substack.com/redirect/7b75de2f-9f0b-4a6e-aa03-0aa0746687ca?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), which Collins raised in the first debate.

Jackson and his second cousin, Lana Pelletier, who also happens to be the mother of their two children, bought the property in September 2019. The mortgage required occupancy within 60 days and use as their principal residence for at least a year. Jackson signed the agreement and initialed the occupancy provision while continuing to identify Allagash as his residence in campaign finance documents.
He later told the Portland newspaper, "This is unfortunate, but I never really read the forms"--comments that amount to an admission that he never intended to make the FHA-financed home his primary residence and never did. Those facts would fit neatly with how the FBI has publicly described mortgage fraud.
His mortgage broker [disputed Jackson's effort to blame him](https://substack.com/redirect/1aac8843-953e-4701-89fc-91d1d8135a5a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for the arrangement.
The Thursday debate reached a fever pitch when Jackson, who had been repeatedly referring to President Trump and the Iran War, accused Collins and her husband of profiting from the Iran War. Chrisos called it a "big claim" and gave Collins the floor.
> "That is absolutely outrageous, and you owe me an apology. That is absolutely outrageous," Collins said.
Jackson did not substantiate the allegation during that exchange, but instead said that it was in fact Collins who owed him an apology.
It's not clear why Jackson believed that Collins owed him an apology.
In keeping with an earlier campaign promise made to POLITICO, Collins has not talked about the fact that Jackson fathered two children with his [second cousin](https://substack.com/redirect/d6a49632-0fae-4af2-8068-7e17c4ad06bd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

_Josh Rogers/NHPR_
At the GOP Senate Primary debate, John Sununu told a room full of Republicans that he's running for Senate to send me back to "bussing tables" at my family's "chicken restaurant."
_He meant it as an insult._
As if working in restaurants -- cooking food, clearing plates, and keeping the family businesses that are the heart of our state alive -- is something to be embarrassed about.
**I 'm not embarrassed. I'm proud of where I came from.**
My family opened our restaurant, the Puritan Backroom, more than 100 years ago. I know what a 65-hour week feels like because I've worked one. I know what it means to show up every day, work hard, and treat the people around you like they matter -- because they do.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d583b384-2494-4107-ae40-f47d7d4ecbff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

I learned my values in that restaurant. I learned to respect hard work, to look people in the eye, and to understand that every job deserves dignity and every worker deserves respect.
**John Sununu has never had to work hard a day in his life.** He was born into a political dynasty. His family's "business" isn't serving New Hampshire families -- it's owning a literal gold mine in Azerbaijan that sells critical minerals to China.
That's what John Sununu calls honest work.
New Hampshire workers deserve a Senator who knows what a hard day's work actually looks like -- who fights for small business owners, for restaurant workers, and for every family just trying to make ends meet.
**John Sununu is running to protect people like himself. I 'm running to stand up for you.**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d583b384-2494-4107-ae40-f47d7d4ecbff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

Sununu's comments showed us who he truly is. He doesn't get how hard Granite Staters work -- and he sure as hell doesn't think that labor is worth respecting.
**I do -- that's why I'm running for Senate.**

**Good Morning!** On this day in 1888, the [Washington Monument](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DFywyAQQNHToM4atAJbFBRp1DmtSwbDStoEgQfW1uT2GecKKX_zin-7uqunRHn99DtaXorLeLSEzFgdHyUU37hxqXvbKWweUyzP1YGE82mQJ2mcD0wvdMp30S6IgGOHdriYQSsJSnWbBfCg8QIR9N1ohfe7DGZUPo6wTEFjR_btDVKaQUoloZ-M0cOk_TQtYKawCCUxEpfafxXKvOGSfsoLax_K3iW7MT-aGD8EzAJmzP1B3_TASL4vdRUwv1vAfPNto7xyye5a8nPHzF218XFQStTOF6HkuntKfyz_88bLwm8AAAD__4sEdas) was opened to the public. Construction began in 1848, but funding challenges and the Civil War took a 40-year toll on the process. A Montana softball player spent years knowing [she had a sister out there somewhere](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGuozAQRb_GdBPZjsnDBcU2dG_bLdEAA3hlPMgzSZS_X7G_8OornXvv-fM9fmPKqWy_8aBeVx4LvSWTKtVR3zwziopyPeRI846UF35uo7f-Ac6CjSPOml40BmyWfiXydG-od1_RtcH6EJq998uEUyAbyIX78iDb3XHG2LnYTivGqUn9xXPWRmdtsP7Wxdi6rsWuW33s5tUES0tSrre_nIrutOYPv6jeZj6a3O-qp5j7L-MH44fyOVn0iowfLrDxg7PGD7YzfngKXA-NHw4uigVhT9sOMu_MGYRXnTBnODN-qMKSZL6KBDKXDTKLgiRRqsAF-DxZUtlACQ9IBSphhpxWghMrFQWteBo_NLVfznfKOcnjywS7HZjy__H6Q-ev3v8LAAD__6JimT0). Then a teammate pointed across the field and said, _" There's a girl on my all-state team who looks just like you."_ The details are below. It got us wondering how many of you have gone digging into your own family tree. Let us know in our poll below. Today's sponsor, [Dr. Steven Gundry](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFuwyAURb8Gb7HgAQYGhkqRO7TJ0CWjheERU-EQGRKrf1-lv9D5Xp0jnctpOrmU0-16divaFst0w71mbA23qe3FF1dbbWVb65r84jCH8rhOQGE4MHqgZnK-pSdOwnXBRkRA3qFlyjApKAjRLdbIWYchMpAaguDDHMF7g2FWLoQoRZfsi8coNYxSQaHXxkimpdM6gtE-EkExpFa2_rukW1sw5p_yxK33Ze2yXVq7V8LfCIwExn3f-zVsd2yvmcD49a7O5yOBkX9epPk4vW58fKRA-JFRoQgM9TEzwo9KCdptNtz3lHOqgyKCXleX8p-o_bPP08JvAAAA___mNXbc), is challenging what you may think you know about "healthy" snacks by revealing which popular choices he says could be working against your waistline goals.

## Storms Taking Aim at Both US Coasts
Tropical Storm Rachel will bring [heavy rain, thunderstorms, and 15-foot waves](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGuozAQRb_GdI7sgRAoKLZx97bdEo3NOMzK2JE9JHp_v2J_4bX3Skf3nj9f6xdy4vz8jQctEsua6dMSiVBd5VNCwSZNSj3awWFHSls5nysYGLU12swrBuE3rQN22xKJgPqOFvuY7X0wMAzdvlAc_Tb73geyHnrrh3GM1gdEmHvw2PFy8awxszVmMHCb5vlupztOU4R5ClENhjaWUm9_C2fZKabv8qZ6C-Xo0rKLvJrqfylwClz-fpUmV6XAXWAFzhoFzjwUuLPp66ECt5-1csBMumLYKelGoqVoXzk_tdTy4oBJV-R8xa2cslPNOmDiWGpmVOC6umyvD6fEbXyowTwP5PR_lvzQ5nuBfwEAAP__70WLGQ) to Southern California this weekend, days after Los Angeles baked through a record five straight 100-degree days. Meanwhile, Hurricane Isaias is [expected to make landfall](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDFurjAQhE8DnZFtDJjCxWvo_temRItZgyODkb2AcvuIX0oukG61MxrNfB-v8QU--H35DxsacnHc8c4BiTCNdEcbIVOmmLa8ebsChjmeyyi5bJngjPcjWPIXjgrK2ThEiXWJRnS9aBSXSpWrQSkm7YTuOmERVC3azrWKy3luZFvzqfTmyROc94JzxWWl-74RugGtney1dYXiOHuKqfqMfqcVXfiKF6bKxq0MZiU6clH_K-RQyOG-72qf7LPj0Z8PAq2YCjmsZ0rewo65kEPwF7IpxOXnPo8ZCDP7dTGfwUNmlOLhLQT2JsGWMzj2JsOS3aHlUvS6TGY-bh-Cz21XKL5s4MO7IP2R62XkdwAAAP__05mPtg) near Pensacola late tonight as a possible Category 3, with evacuations underway and states of emergency in Florida, Alabama, and Georgia. In California, showers could start Saturday night, with the heaviest rain Sunday into Monday. Forecasters warn of coastal flooding and [dangerous rip currents](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOpDAQRL_GZCC7MYwJHFxCNpdeiDymAZ-Me2T3YO3fr9hf2LRKKtV7_57L04UY0v7XnWh5oyVhLRGZMS9cyZMrXJjyWc7gD4dxpc--gISxVbKV0-I8hwsX7ZrVboiAfYNWPSY1aAlaN4cdAc1mlIGHMgaGUferM6gkjL2Uau2bYO89JeWkpNQSOjNNgzKDM2aDyfhNaIlrYMrdfwqJD9ziF12YO09nE-3B_C6i_yNgFjDXWjv_KjfH3QuYIxWXdoxYBMx3LmAu9OEDc2q9i2GjnIJryTO9MLcHOm6ru7D1RHGlmgTMTbbru4YYQxkfQsv9dCH-HOBferssfAcAAP__8VGD3Q) along the coast. The moisture then pushes into Arizona and Nevada, where Phoenix and Las Vegas could see [2 to 3 inches of rain](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL9y8yAQxJ9G6tCgM_pDQfE17vy1KTUXOCQySHjgbOK3zzh6hJR3s7uzv_24LTcMMRzrf9zJsE_LQbVEYqa8cE02YeHCKe9lD3ZDii491gUkjKKXQuoFLYcnLQpbZzwR0KUl00-6H5QEpdrNjGCHCUY_olL-U7vZeq8HO84D9BNY1wbzzuul1L2USkI3az3084Dz7EHP1jdKkguccveVwsEb-fhKT8qdTXsbzcZ8L83lXwPXBq611s6n70rI2yl5P89LvOkauGbMJBgjCa5JnJDicfgUXRGc0z1YjKK8CtNeBGNeicX6iF5UKnwa2mzcvYYYQxmnRsl1xxB_G_Efh3wa-AkAAP__3tiMdQ). It could be only the third time since 1963 that tropical systems hit both U.S. coasts at once.
## US Suspends Microsoft from Green Card Program
The Trump administration has [suspended Microsoft and Adobe](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFuwyAQxvGnwZutgxDHDAxdvKVrRwvDYVNhLoJLrL59lb5C50_6fdL_677cXcqpbJ_uQMuRloJny8iMdeGTPLnGjake7Uh-d5gDPbdFgRp7CT2YxXlOL1y064KNiAovHVp5M_KqQWnd7dZIowKsZh2DjBolXsBoPU4RV41Sj12yb08CGAmgQQ2TMVc5Xd00RWUmH4UGDImpDt-UCu8Y8w-9sA6eji7bnfnRxOVDqFmo-TzPwZfVv0eh5jct1CxBqBkmoeYj-UqNIvcu0Ir9VhFL710NfXYr1b492wNLS1SGnY_cVRseZ8o5tfEmNGyHS_nvmf8Z7GXVbwAAAP__tcZ_rg) from the program that lets employers sponsor foreign workers for green cards, accusing them of abusing the visa system. Several IT outsourcing firms were suspended as well. Vice President JD Vance said Microsoft laid off 6,000 American workers last year while obtaining [6,300 H-1B visas](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGunDAQRb8GOq-MgV1cuEhD99KmRMYewyS2B3kMZP8-2vzCa6-ujo7Or6_ly2LEvP20CUwNtGS4OUKtUJZ6kyPLlSuVxAndbiF6OrdFSfUUnRRSL9ZVvGAZbOtNAFDQt2C6l-7GQaphaHcTXlL3vvewhvDUa3B9_5SjHBXocdVuaNF8eJ2UupNykOoxaT1202inKSg9udAMEjxWKo_fhLnuEOKbLigPR6mNZq_14Kb_0ai5UfN9349Af9eTMQPz59Oo-aCIFR03ar5sdiD45AOyZ5HQFWIKVVDdobAIhZIIVAC3LG4qfz6jPY74xryJrQBk4WzxLKxzJwMLR-mw-S0uZCvsejK0xfjjxhiRn69mkFuyGP_r1m9Wvoz6FwAA__85i5gt) and nearly 3,000 green cards. Microsoft said most of its U.S. employees are Americans and that [80% of its H-1B filings](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2u3CAUhJ8Gd6wAY19cUKRxd9OmtFg42GfFjwVnbeXto00eId1II43m-359b98OE5b9p8tgKdatwN0TEEHb6K6-uk6dass9oz8cpFDf-6aEmrkUXCyb84QXbNoNwUYABeMAVn4tctJCaT0c1jtpxjloKUeQHsQkzNNMPsYlTl4JOaD97EkhFimEFuphlmWSZnLGRLUYH5kWEJBqe7wqFjogpt_1gvbwNQ_JHkRnZ-MPplam1vu-H-XpPxyfnqn1rAkJfWdqpfbOJ3chY8FOzRHWwtSa0bfaayTe3_2EEiDwvQEU7l0LnR9cPvmF3fEXl__C5YoH3nxxs1Cj1EOz4bwxJezzF9Nizw7T34P0n14vq_4EAAD__y9Fj4s) covered existing staff, not new hires. The move came a day after Homeland Security proposed a [$70,000 fee](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykULuOpDAQ_BqTGbV7zCtwcAnZXHoh8tgNeM5gZPeA9u9X7C9sUpWU6vXvOT1tiGFf_tqNDM9p2ukqkZgpT3wll2zhwilvZQtutRR9-iwTArZSgYRhso7DSZO2lTczEdKjIqO6QTUaUOtqNQ90vu8atDO-Wg9d2zRtozpNANhq21bB3H4KYFAAGrDuh6FRfWP7fsahd7PQQD5wyvU7hZ1XmuNXOinXLm1VNCvzUcTjj8BR4HhdV-3XUi_pFDjecwSOd4DAUYHAETqBo1-LPHI6UqEiZ7ohZQrLLgt_PO0sr5T_35Il2-1mJsfSbpSDs7t8p1epsvHHFWIMpe2EhmWzIf504l9eeRr8DgAA___AJokH) that colleges would pay for every international student who takes a job through a student work program.
## ISS Astronauts Return After 237 Days
Four astronauts [splashed down](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOqzAQRb8GOiPbQIILF6-hy2tfiebZQ5iVsZE9ibN_vwqr_YLt5uiMrq7uv9tyAwoU739hR8trWiLWEpAZ88I1uQSFC6e8l53cBhh8etwXLfVFKCmkWcAxPXEZoPV2RdTYt2jV1ahxkHoY2s2q0evR-_9aege983I1owI04JSaDPQt2XeektIoKQepu8mYUU0jTNOqzeTWZpDoiVPuPhJF3nANn-mJuXNpb4PdmI_S9H8aPTd6rrV25QCHb9vo-bwFvo6QMjCl2OiZImOOJ0EQ3x-Ff-zJL-EyVqG0oFIEFM4pwoPFTqVQiiIjP3IUnARC5q3N1h-VQqByuTaDvO9A4ezHv5z1afVXAAAA___qMpGJ) in the Pacific off Los Angeles yesterday morning, closing out a 237-day mission aboard the International Space Station. The _SpaceX Dragon_ capsule undocked on Wednesday and spent about 27 hours making its way home. Today's sponsor, , is challenging what you may think you know about "healthy" snacks by revealing which popular choices he says could be working against your waistline goals. | Storms Taking Aim at Both US Coasts Tropical Storm Rachel will bring to Southern California this weekend, days after Los Angeles baked through a record five straight 100-degree days. Meanwhile, Hurricane Isaias is near Pensacola late tonight as a possible Category 3, with evacuations underway and states of emergency in Florida, Alabama, and Georgia. In California, showers could start Saturday night, with the heaviest rain Sunday into Monday. Forecasters warn of coastal flooding and along the coast. The moisture then pushes into Arizona and Nevada, where Phoenix and Las Vegas could see . It could be only the third time since 1963 that tropical systems hit both U.S. coasts at once. US Suspends Microsoft from Green Card Program The Trump administration has from the program that lets employers sponsor foreign workers for green cards, accusing them of abusing the visa system. Several IT outsourcing firms were suspended as well. Vice President JD Vance said Microsoft laid off 6,000 American workers last year while obtaining and nearly 3,000 green cards. Microsoft said most of its U.S. employees are Americans and that covered existing staff, not new hires. The move came a day after Homeland Security proposed a that colleges would pay for every international student who takes a job through a student work program. ISS Astronauts Return After 237 Days Four astronauts in the Pacific off Los Angeles yesterday morning, closing out a 237-day mission aboard the International Space Station. The SpaceX Dragon capsule undocked on Wednesday and spent about 27 hours making its way home. NASA's Jessica Meir and Jack Hathaway, the European Space Agency's Sophie Adenot, and Russia's Andrey Fedyaev launched in February and logged in orbit. body:
I want to start by saying thank you to everyone who has donated to make the Ground Truth Bus Program possible.
#
Hi there,
I want to start by saying _thank you_ to everyone who has donated to make the Ground Truth Bus Program possible.
When we announced this program a little more than a month ago, we had an ambitious goal of raising $100,000 to secure 33 buses to transport volunteers from cities like New York, DC, Boston, San Francisco, and more to neighboring swing districts. And a few weeks later, we increased that number to 37 buses.
**Thanks to the incredible support of the Swing Left community, we’ve now raised over $93,000 toward our goal, and we’ve already sent 16 buses full of volunteers out to canvass in swing districts across the country!**
[](https://act.swingleft.org/go/2620?t=1&akid=3081%2E1562180%2ETfhOGQ)
This program is really making an impact. It breaks down the single biggest barrier to volunteering by providing free, direct transportation for eager volunteers in blue cities straight to the front lines of the most competitive swing districts in the country.
Next weekend, October 17th and 18th, we’re sending out more buses than any other week of this election cycle. It’s our biggest Weekend of Action yet, and we still need help to raise the final $7,000 needed to reach our $100,000 Bus Fund goal.
**If you were waiting for the right time to donate, this is it![If you can, please consider making a contribution to the Ground Truth Bus Fund before this weekend to help secure our final buses of the year.](https://act.swingleft.org/go/2620?t=3&akid=3081%2E1562180%2ETfhOGQ)**
**[Donate Now](https://act.swingleft.org/go/2620?t=4&akid=3081%2E1562180%2ETfhOGQ)**
We’re incredibly excited about the momentum headed into this election, and I’m personally deeply grateful to everyone who has made this bus program possible. In just a few short weeks, we’ll see all of our work pay off!
Thank you again,
Matt Caffrey
Senior Organizing Director, Swing Left
P.S. Live near one of our bus departure locations? Hop on and come canvass with Swing Left volunteers! [**Click here to see all available buses.**](https://act.swingleft.org/go/2621?t=5&akid=3081%2E1562180%2ETfhOGQ)

**Since 2017, Swing Left has channeled the energy of grassroots volunteers and donors to elect Democrats, up and down the ballot, focusing on the most competitive races that can swing the national balance of power.** Right now, Swing Left is investing in grassroots organizing in key swing districts and initiatives across the country to flip the House and win the Senate and critical states in 2026. [**If you’d like to help support our work, you can make a donation using this link.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_sl_footer?refcode=em20261009-1&t=6&refcode2=3081_1562180_TfhOGQ&akid=3081%2E1562180%2ETfhOGQ)

## Trump Rallies Texas Voters for Paxton
President Trump [campaigned for Senate candidate](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGuszAQBODTQGe0NhBC4eJv0uVvX4kWvA5WjG3ZSyC3f0qu8MrRSJ9G83Of7ui8C4__uJHm08Yp0FE8MVOetli4cKZS7O7R5RQzz36nOClQFyFBwDjhwu5FU4e10TOYUdak5TDKvmuHoa1XbZSFdh5mtMbIxUjTQq-wV-21XSyouXb6w0mAUUpQvWw6RXQ1ABZ7e-0Jqg7IOI654ZWYTizWv-OLcrPErfZ6ZU6lav9V6lap23EczfPE8CkrdeOYROGYHZVPyvuWBEdREuFTIIuCQWDgGFwUGb1_i8PxKhKeHIPIlPbZuwWDWDAYZ5C_Tp21SYfz3pXLUHXw2ND57xz-640vrX4DAAD___pAjF0) Ken Paxton at San Antonio's Freeman Coliseum Wednesday night, saying that if elected in the race against Democrat James Talarico, Paxton would be "one of the best Senators that we have in this country." Trump also [revisited his remark](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLHOozAQhJ_GdEb2AgEKF9e4y7VXog1eJ1aMjexNSN7-xP8Kfz3SzHzfv-tyxRBDuv_FjQx_fF4SHTUSM5Vly5UrF6rVvyKGsufCt_iivICCi9RKqnnBlcOblh4bZ27Kzboho8dZD303jl3zMG5db90wOMBJ40yDp9mPCDDTNPb6oppgzjqt1Ky1gkG3PRBNTimPg58GUqJX5ALn0vKDmD5YffzmN5V2zVsTzYN5r6L7I8AKsMdxtM-KfIYC7MkjwMa8YhRgzykBVisBVk0CLOOT8MBvlb7kTe6FanCUWLqcMDrJ5bXtVRaM8StDkhWTxMQ5hSzANsW4_QgxhnoZRa_uG4b4c4t_q_Nt4H8AAAD__wC9i8M) from Monday that an Iranian nuclear weapon could destroy San Diego and Los Angeles, telling the crowd, "_We're not going to let that happen. We protect our cities_." The president said he'll [award Roger Clemens](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkD2O4zAMhU8jdwoo-i8uVGzjbrbd0mAsKhEgWYZEx5PbLzxXmI4AHz587_37Wr4oxLA9_1JiK98-LxufNbIIlyXlKlUK1-qPSKHsucgjHpwXBBy0AQ3TQquENy8dNc4-wE2mYWvGyfRdO45t87KDx-HRI00DQDtwC9AagsfI7XRn6tom2AtnACZjAHtz65D57gA89f7eM6gO2AXJ5SYvFv6m6uMnv7nc1pyaaF8ie1XtH4Wzwvk8z9tRSbKjzxVQOO9hlaOwflKMXD4K56vl9cgxSFiv83JQOBtQOMOocHZ5o-i0lCPtuuQnF71GTrxVndhR1NlrX5hdTnp_ZckXZULT9fcR4QfRFOv2M8QY6jCqDp6JQvyRlt-O_bb4PwAA__-GvZPI) the Presidential Medal of Freedom, calling the seven-time Cy Young winner "maybe the greatest pitcher of all time." Clemens, kept out of the Hall of Fame over steroid allegations, introduced Trump onstage. At least a dozen protesters [interrupted the speech](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLHOozAQhJ_GdI5sYyAULq6hy7VXosVewuqMjewlyb39ibzC3400o9E38-cxP4Aipedv2NHxZ81zwneNyIxl3nPlygVrXc8IVI5ceIkn5tko00utpBpn8EwvnC00wS0qjLpBp4dRd7YdhrbZHNqu8wHHXgO2w90Pg0aD2i52sV0f2obcVaeVGrVWptM3axDvQakVuvXeoRJWYSDO5cYbMn6grvFffmG5-bw30W3MRxXtL2EmYSa_VDgrU7pcYaZrkDBTzB6iMBOXcz9kgRgJq6QkKyQJiXOiLNdcZMUEjNJDChQu9ReTPODDOV1xpufG8kshC3hsigvHm2Kk2g_CqucOFL9g_NNDX878DwAA___h1o96), and police escorted some out. Trump said in an interview at the rally that Republicans "have to win" in November, calling a victory "an affirmation."

Dallas/Fort Worth International Airport (DFW) was named the [most stressful airport](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LtutDAQBeCngc5ofONSuPgbuv3blGgWxruWzBrZA2zePiKK8gLpphgdne983KYbhhhej_-4kuO3T9OLzhKJmfK0psKFM5Xi94ghbynzPe6UJgWqFRIEDBPOHA6aDNaLu8MyyJqc7AZpje46XT-d7lrrTU--1WBtDy1pf9e21WTIY2_q4K44CTBICcrKxiiifgHwaH1vCSoDtAROueEnMb2x-PiZDsrNnNY6uifzVir9r1JjpcbzPBuf3uaCXA-VGq-zUuOWtj1iFnsRPxoxY4y0iLSzuLTilytwpRxmFJzxoEi51Nkt2xliDKXtKgOPFUP8bsB_Xe5w6isAAP__W_GHfA) in the country in a new study of the 55 busiest U.S. airports, released by a Tampa-based airport parking company. DFW Ranked America's Most Stressful Airport Dallas/Fort Worth International Airport (DFW) was named the in the country in a new study of the 55 busiest U.S. airports, released by a Tampa-based airport parking company. The study : delay rate, cancellation rate, the extent to which delays have worsened since 2021, and the distance and drive time from downtown. It used 2025 federal flight data and Google Maps estimates. DFW had the highest delay rate in the study, 27.86%, and the third-highest cancellation rate, at 2.76%, making it the only airport to on both. Texas' four other major airports did not make the top 10 most stressful. Delays at DFW have increased by 33.67% since 2021, and the airport is about 20 miles from downtown Dallas. | | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/20697f6cba1e/stand-up-against-the-shameful-gop-power-grab-7363925?e=dc5f639d62)

**Hey friends,** My friend Dr. Theotis Robinson Jr. is a man who has spent more than 60 years helping Tennessee live up to its promises. [**[CLICK HERE to LISTEN NOW**]](https://us.list-manage.com/apTFaglcGY9?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0)
****
[**Listen or watch**](https://us.list-manage.com/NJY0bjQvGMI?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0)**now wherever you get your podcasts. 🎧**

We've been conspiring together for as long as I've been in politics, and this conversation is one I've been wanting to have for a long time.Dr. Robinson grew up in segregated Knoxville, took part in the lunch counter sit-ins as a teenager, and at 18 sat down and wrote his application to the University of Tennessee the night he learned the undergraduate school didn't admit Black students. When the university said no, he told its leaders he'd sue if they didn't change the policy. They changed it, and in January 1961 he enrolled as [UT's first Black undergraduate. ](https://us.list-manage.com/UggkPOVutn9?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0)
He went on to become a vice president of equity and diversity for the UT system, and in 2019, a UT dormitory was named in his honor.
He didn't stop there. In 1969 he won a seat on the Knoxville City Council, the first Black member since 1912, and used it to push for long-overdue promotions for Black police officers and firefighters and to get Black representation on the city's boards. He's still organizing today, working to get young people out to vote and pushing back on the attacks on diversity, equity, and inclusion.We talk about what it was like growing up under segregation, what _one seat_ at the table can actually change, and why, after everything he's lived through, he says "I don't get discouraged." His message is the one we all need right now: the republic is ours to keep, but we have to show up and do the work. Early voting happens October 14-29 and Election Day is November 3rd. Make a plan to vote.
Thank you for being here,
Gloria

body:
[ stdin# ]Josh Shapiro for Pennsylvania
Derek, we have a
problem — and it's a good one.

Our volunteers have signed up to knock on 100,000 doors across
Pennsylvania this weekend — the biggest canvass of our entire campaign so
far.

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/16268?t=1001&akid=565%2E245147%2ECsrLUY ]But here's the issue: We don't have enough literature printed to cover
it. Every door we send a volunteer to without campaign literature in hand
is a conversation that doesn't stick. So please, will you chip in just $3
(or more!) right away and sponsor campaign literature for a few more
doors?

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/16268?t=1002&akid=565%2E245147%2ECsrLUY ]Sponsor 1 door for $3 →
[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/16269?t=1003&akid=565%2E245147%2ECsrLUY ]Sponsor 10 doors for $30 →
[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/16270?t=1004&akid=565%2E245147%2ECsrLUY ]Sponsor 50 doors for $150 →
[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/16271?t=1005&akid=565%2E245147%2ECsrLUY ]Other →

Here's what those contributions actually do,
Derek.

A volunteer knocks. Somebody answers, or doesn't. Either way, that piece
of campaign literature stays behind — on the porch, on the fridge, in the
stack by the door — with Josh's record on it, long after the conversation
ends.

And when you’re running for reelection in a Commonwealth where statewide
elections have come down to a point or less, that's not a nice-to-have.
It's a make-or-break margin.

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/16268?t=1006&akid=565%2E245147%2ECsrLUY ]So please: Chip in $3 or whatever you can today. Because 100,000
Pennsylvanians are going to open their doors this weekend — and the
far-right is betting on us to show up empty-handed.

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your
donation will go through immediately:

Shapiro for Governor Organizing Team

Hey Peter, if you haven't had a minute to read this note from Hakeem Jeffries, it’s worth your time. First of all, he talks about you — the work you and this movement are doing to push back against shameless Republican attempts to rig the midterms. And he explains in the clearest terms how much there is still to fight for. This man is poised to be the next Speaker of the House — take a minute to hear him out, [then split a donation between Hakeem Jeffries’ campaign and the NDRC to ramp up our defense of democracy in the home stretch of this election.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/140998221/652233610/-1228467920?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_JeffriesTopper_email_20261009-NDRC-Tier1-JeffriesTopper_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20261009-NDRC-Tier1-JeffriesTopper_&utm_campaign=JeffriesTopper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImVlNjAzZjY1LWRhYzMtZjExMS1iZjViLTAwMGQzYTRmYmU4MyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=z1P4ezRBXep9g87ylvqTTX4qo1aezeYUT24fGjBYXRc=) Thank you, Brianna \------------------Forwarded Message------------------ Peter, you don’t need me to tell you how much is at stake on November 3rd. The outcome of the midterms won’t just determine the direction our country takes for the next two years — I believe we’ll be feeling the impact for most of the next decade. [(If you’ve heard enough and want to help win this election, split a donation with the NDRC and my campaign today.)](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/140998222/652233611/-1228467920?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_JeffriesTopper_email_20261009-NDRC-Tier1-JeffriesTopper_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20261009-NDRC-Tier1-JeffriesTopper_&utm_campaign=JeffriesTopper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImVlNjAzZjY1LWRhYzMtZjExMS1iZjViLTAwMGQzYTRmYmU4MyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=z1P4ezRBXep9g87ylvqTTX4qo1aezeYUT24fGjBYXRc=) [With your support, we’ve been holding those gerrymanderers accountable and working to help elect fair maps champions who can stop the next power grab before it starts.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/140998223/652233612/-1228467920?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_JeffriesTopper_email_20261009-NDRC-Tier1-JeffriesTopper_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20261009-NDRC-Tier1-JeffriesTopper_&utm_campaign=JeffriesTopper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImVlNjAzZjY1LWRhYzMtZjExMS1iZjViLTAwMGQzYTRmYmU4MyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=z1P4ezRBXep9g87ylvqTTX4qo1aezeYUT24fGjBYXRc=) Let’s be clear — they tried to stack the deck against us. Donald Trump demanded that Republicans in states across the country tear up their maps and redraw congressional districts in the middle of the decade to give themselves the upper hand. Here’s the thing: Thanks to the leadership of Attorney General Holder and the quick, aggressive action from the National Democratic Redistricting Committee, the Republican gerrymandering scheme failed. Together, we organized, we got the word out, and we even shut down Republican attempts to rig maps. We passed countermeasures to ensure that the true will of the people gets heard. We stood up and fought for our representative democracy, and we’re still fighting today. And you know what? In spite of the rotten politics and dirty tricks from the other side, **we are in a position to win back the House of Representatives in November.** That’s not why I’m writing today. The truth is, we now know that the GOP has a plan they intend to put in motion as soon as the midterms end. They’re already laying the groundwork to advance new gerrymanders in several states — even in states that just redrew their map a year ago. The lesson they’re learning from this year isn’t that they need better policies that actually help the American people. **No, Republicans have decided they simply didn’t cheat hard enough.** Thanks to people like you, the fair maps movement and the NDRC, we are ready for the fight ahead. We will not be caught flat-footed in this critical moment for our democracy. I’m asking for your help. To defend democracy, we need to demonstrate the best of democracy, and that means all of us working together. [You can make a big difference in the fight ahead — if you can, split a donation between my campaign and the NDRC today.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/140998224/652233613/-1228467920?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_JeffriesTopper_email_20261009-NDRC-Tier1-JeffriesTopper_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20261009-NDRC-Tier1-JeffriesTopper_&utm_campaign=JeffriesTopper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImVlNjAzZjY1LWRhYzMtZjExMS1iZjViLTAwMGQzYTRmYmU4MyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=z1P4ezRBXep9g87ylvqTTX4qo1aezeYUT24fGjBYXRc=) | _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_

clean_body: We’ll need all hands on deck to defend democracy | Hey Peter, if you haven't had a minute to read this note from Hakeem Jeffries, it’s worth your time. First of all, he talks about you — the work you and this movement are doing to push back against shameless Republican attempts to rig the midterms. And he explains in the clearest terms how much there is still to fight for. This man is poised to be the next Speaker of the House — take a minute to hear him out, = Thank you, Brianna \------------------Forwarded Message------------------ Peter, you don’t need me to tell you how much is at stake on November 3rd. The outcome of the midterms won’t just determine the direction our country takes for the next two years — I believe we’ll be feeling the impact for most of the next decade. = = Let’s be clear — they tried to stack the deck against us. Donald Trump demanded that Republicans in states across the country tear up their maps and redraw congressional districts in the middle of the decade to give themselves the upper hand. Here’s the thing: Thanks to the leadership of Attorney General Holder and the quick, aggressive action from the National Democratic Redistricting Committee, the Republican gerrymandering scheme failed. Together, we organized, we got the word out, and we even shut down Republican attempts to rig maps. We passed countermeasures to ensure that the true will of the people gets heard. We stood up and fought for our representative democracy, and we’re still fighting today. And you know what? In spite of the rotten politics and dirty tricks from the other side, we are in a position to win back the House of Representatives in November. That’s not why I’m writing today. The truth is, we now know that the GOP has a plan they intend to put in motion as soon as the midterms end. They’re already laying the groundwork to advance new gerrymanders in several states — even in states that just redrew their map a year ago. The lesson they’re learning from this year isn’t that they need better policies that actually help the American people. No, Republicans have decided they simply didn’t cheat hard enough. Thanks to people like you, the fair maps movement and the NDRC, we are ready for the fight ahead. We will not be caught flat-footed in this critical moment for our democracy. I’m asking for your help. name: Tammy Baldwin
subject: Sharing my story

body:
# [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/3095?t=1&akid=5732%2E35263%2EfJ6P-f)
Peter, have you heard my story?
When I was growing up, I spent three months in the hospital from a serious illness. My grandparents, who raised me, looked for an insurance policy after I left to cover future costs.
But here’s what happened: they couldn’t find a single policy that covered me — all because I had a pre-existing condition from my illness — which meant they had to pay for my care out of pocket. Peter, like so many others, the exorbitant costs of paying for care kept them up at night worried about how they would be able to afford it.
Seeing my grandparents go through that struggle was one of the reasons I ran for office. I didn’t want another family to go through what we went through and worry about how they were going to afford care.
As Senator, I was proud to support the Affordable Care Act and advocate to ensure insurance companies cannot deny coverage or charge higher rates for individuals with pre-existing health conditions.
**[I believe everyone should have access to quality and affordable care. I won’t stop fighting for that. If you are able, can you chip in right now to help me continue this work in Congress?](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/6050?c0=em-ms-tb-20261009-healthcarechampion.nUX56X&amount=10&refcode=em20261009-5732&t=2&akid=5732%2E35263%2EfJ6P-f)**

name: Andrew Sypher, Turning Point USA
subject: When Charlie said “35,000,” I laughed...
body:
| | |
---
| | Patriot,
---
I'm going to be blunt with you.

We are closer to losing this country than most people are willing to admit.

Not someday. Not "if things keep going this way."

Right now.

And the scariest part?

It's not happening in Washington. It's happening in classrooms.

High schools. Colleges.

Places where the next generation is being shaped -- or more accurately... reshaped.

If you've ever looked at what's coming out of our schools and thought: _" What happened to this country?" _

You're not wrong. You're seeing it clearly.

Because while most people are arguing online... while they're hoping things will turn around... while they're waiting for the next election to fix everything...

The other side is doing something far more dangerous.

They're raising the next generation.

Earlier. Faster. And with zero resistance in most places.

That's how countries are lost.

Slowly. Then all at once.

But here's the thing that should give a patriot like you hope...

There is one place where that trend is actually being challenged.

_And it shouldn 't even exist. _

**Just one year ago, Turning Point USA 's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools.**
That alone felt like a miracle.

Because starting even ONE chapter today takes courage most adults don't have.

Conservative students get mocked. Targeted. Threatened. Shut down.

And yet...

_They stepped up anyway. _

About that time, Charlie called me.

He didn't sound optimistic... He sounded urgent.

"Andrew, we've got to move faster."

I told him we were. He stopped me.

"No. You're not thinking what I'm thinking. I want to be in 35,000 high schools."

I actually laughed.

"Charlie... there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America."

"Okay," he said. "How many are there?"

"About 27,000."

And without hesitation: "Good. Let's do 27,000."

I remember sitting there thinking to myself... we're barely in 1,200 schools.

We didn't have the staff. We didn't have the infrastructure. We didn't even have the roadmap yet.

But Charlie wasn't fazed.

_" We'll figure it out." _

That was him.

He didn't wait for perfect conditions.

Because he knew something most people don't want to face: If we wait... _we lose everything. _

And now?

Less than a year later...

**We 're in 3,300 schools. **

**Thirteen percent of all high schools in America. **

**Eight states are now backing this effort to put a Club America chapter in every high school statewide. **

_That shouldn 't be possible. _

Not in this environment. Not with the level of hostility these students face every single day.

And yet... it's still happening.

_But Patriot, here 's the part you need to understand: _

This is not a victory. It's a foothold.

_Because in the other 87% of schools? _

There is no resistance. None.

Just one-sided propaganda from the Left.

One-sided pressure on kids who are too young to even realize what's happening to them.

That's the reality.

The question isn't whether we're fighting. We are.

The question is whether it's enough.

Because right now, the students stepping up through Club America...

They're not the majority. _They 're the exception. _

They're the ones willing to take the heat.

The ones willing to stand alone.

The ones willing to risk being targeted just to say: _" I love this country." _

We have a choice.

Back them. _Or leave them on their own. _

**Because when a student starts a chapter, we send them an activism kit -- with American flags. Pocket Constitutions. Leadership tools. **

Everything they need to actually stand their ground.

Not symbolically. For real.

They've already made the decision to lead.

All they're waiting on... is you and me.

**Each activism kit costs $25. That 's it. **

$25 to make sure one student doesn't have to stand alone against the Left in a hostile school.

$25 to put real tools in their hands.

$25 to push back -- even if it's one campus at a time.

Club America isn't slowing down. It's accelerating.

Because every day, more students are stepping forward.

Not because it's easy or popular...

_But because they know what 's at stake. _

They're starting chapters in schools where they were told not to.

They're speaking truth in classrooms where the Left once went unchallenged.

They're choosing courage in places designed to make them conform.

And they're not alone.

They're finding each other. They're bringing more students with them every day.

They're building something real -- rooted in faith and freedom, grounded in truth, and unafraid to say that America is worth defending.

Not from the top down... _But from the ground up. _

One student. One school. One chapter at a time.

But only if we move fast enough.

Because the Left isn't slowing down. They're not taking a break.

They're not afraid to push their anti-American ideas in every classroom they're in.

And if we don't match that urgency... if we don't meet that moment with equal conviction...

Then the generational window Charlie Kirk opened to save our country closes.

And once it closes... It closes for good.

clean_body: | | | | | Patriot, I'm going to be blunt with you. We are closer to losing this country than most people are willing to admit. Not someday. Not "if things keep going this way." Right now. And the scariest part? It's not happening in Washington. It's happening in classrooms. High schools. Colleges. Places where the next generation is being shaped -- or more accurately... reshaped. If you've ever looked at what's coming out of our schools and thought: " What happened to this country?" You're not wrong. You're seeing it clearly. Because while most people are arguing online... while they're hoping things will turn around... while they're waiting for the next election to fix everything... The other side is doing something far more dangerous. They're raising the next generation. Earlier. Faster. And with zero resistance in most places. That's how countries are lost. Slowly. Then all at once. But here's the thing that should give a patriot like you hope... There is one place where that trend is actually being challenged. And it shouldn 't even exist. Just one year ago, Turning Point USA 's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools. That alone felt like a miracle. Because starting even ONE chapter today takes courage most adults don't have. Conservative students get mocked. Targeted. Threatened. Shut down. And yet... They stepped up anyway. About that time, Charlie called me. He didn't sound optimistic... He sounded urgent. "Andrew, we've got to move faster." I told him we were. He stopped me. "No. You're not thinking what I'm thinking. I want to be in 35,000 high schools." I actually laughed. "Charlie... there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America." "Okay," he said. "How many are there?" "About 27,000." And without hesitation: "Good. Let's do 27,000." I remember sitting there thinking to myself... we're barely in 1,200 schools. We didn't have the staff. We didn't have the infrastructure. We didn't even have the roadmap yet. But Charlie wasn't fazed. " We'll figure it out." That was him. He didn't wait for perfect conditions. Because he knew something most people don't want to face: If we wait... we lose everything. And now? Less than a year later... We 're in 3,300 schools. Thirteen percent of all high schools in America. Eight states are now backing this effort to put a Club America chapter in every high school statewide. That shouldn 't be possible. Not in this environment. Not with the level of hostility these students face every single day. And yet... it's still happening. But Patriot, here 's the part you need to understand: This is not a victory. It's a foothold. Because in the other 87% of schools? There is no resistance. None. Just one-sided propaganda from the Left. One-sided pressure on kids who are too young to even realize what's happening to them. That's the reality. The question isn't whether we're fighting. We are. But here's what gives me hope, Patriot... Club America isn't slowing down. It's accelerating. Because every day, more students are stepping forward. Not because it's easy or popular... But because they know what 's at stake. They're starting chapters in schools where they were told not to. They're speaking truth in classrooms where the Left once went unchallenged. They're choosing courage in places designed to make them conform. And they're not alone. They're finding each other. They're bringing more students with them every day. They're building something real -- rooted in faith and freedom, grounded in truth, and unafraid to say that America is worth defending. That's how movements are built. Not from the top down... But from the ground up. One student. One school. One chapter at a time. And Patriot -- that's exactly how we take this country back. But only if we move fast enough. Because the Left isn't slowing down. They're not taking a break. They're not afraid to push their anti-American ideas in every classroom they're in. **My name is Joe Males, and I’m running for United States Congress in California’s 25th district.** [**This is a longer email, but I humbly ask you to read it and consider donating to my campaign at the end.**](http://links.joemalesforca.com/u/click?_t=87a0bf2fd7e446429f4e355f2cd52f45&_m=7eb3520fc4e24ac1a20b4c3861be3182&_e=rZ03XUXdoFCKRTUv3kST4W_qTw-HMZghewaktoQBSjeLLHm1Hubj9koM219hbr2l-8BFYM4x1UqZ07p5EQcmPevrefz6R3EvqnPSxqcjhfcX68rt_tJdTbMRmwWrDBrBTd521qL809aBVhjymf3RGOlfpNUIB2DTtXRHEcM2Wv1UpuF78aB-_JGmTVahzAACmRdZC_hVD7lausZDJMSSuh4puPOA0WdXftUnZ64QyCCyM8emzO5kmbIPpFcyCcveN26qKAkG82hT3qxaFUhG18OfEJClAOLsFbVjnOQqe6GHIuEuudR9XJ8-EECM9aAxW7irwApSLvAXq2KIc--RFiiYGJwaZ_6kQXY9ZboMee9NXuoLwK75XFf0ivkkQc3wCtPJCjvoD0wKPPXvzIcZkim2JEnulZD_z5-OP3ChUaONFe_rYY9ZcQYgg1zppH7TTt3abEJBR_wdw8WqGp2eYvfx1ToN6S71OF7mNObxdj3NJ-uA1I6VROPqYGOWlc9a6KB0jQdH3owLSE2_8cM76Z-b--AnaAeCAX0D_HF5434%3D)

**WHO AM I?** [](http://links.joemalesforca.com/u/click?_t=87a0bf2fd7e446429f4e355f2cd52f45&_m=7eb3520fc4e24ac1a20b4c3861be3182&_e=rZ03XUXdoFCKRTUv3kST4W_qTw-HMZghewaktoQBSjeLLHm1Hubj9koM219hbr2l-8BFYM4x1UqZ07p5EQcmPevrefz6R3EvqnPSxqcjhfcX68rt_tJdTbMRmwWrDBrBzq_TeZ5purV5U7bgZPkPaL5eMFM0LJNvVs866p6zcw7x5czzXo2Rkhm-a0yB3COYLYY7wYNktk7Pk29483iFPJniTs2zswfeFFkysIfjqw8_-0wdASMUhZzxZYE465SJqSNRhqDyv3tuOJJlJgX3yAHHdi0b4qcjPGU4J1H3-fqdM7sddxMQrI93PALy0JBdNDkhVcS58waxK0m4Ft0imJ9xBw1ETwDnCxrqKayq-4ywuFCTCVnMABwMmtgkixX-T5As3oNjyOLlP14cTcUQrl8QTx5jHZ8-DgNxTRiMV5OpzZ8qcxPeWQNAjWKGXV-ohEltTzhfbG-GxPprw8AqchAhbJmNilLDIMBZcV82JYOeZtLZ0pN-gZqIDQkq_fZ-WoxMLrBMz2KH45U2Q0MZIg%3D%3D)

_Like I said, I’m Joe Males. I’m a Mexican-American who was adopted by two wonderful parents when I was four years old._

**At a young age, I joined the United States Marine Corps to defend our country and ultimately earned the rank of Sergeant before my discharge.** Once I entered civilian life, I started my entrepreneurial career owning a successful small computer business until my son took over the family business.

**Since the Democrats will want to use this to attack me, I will tell you: I was a former Democrat.** I switched over to the Republican Party during the Reagan era once I saw what the Democrats truly stood for. I’ve seen firsthand how today’s Democratic Party has abandoned working families. Every single day, I hear from constituents who are struggling with everyday challenges. I hear them, and I fully agree with them. It’s time for change in California.

**WHY DID I ENTER POLITICS?** [](http://links.joemalesforca.com/u/click?_t=87a0bf2fd7e446429f4e355f2cd52f45&_m=7eb3520fc4e24ac1a20b4c3861be3182&_e=rZ03XUXdoFCKRTUv3kST4W_qTw-HMZghewaktoQBSjeLLHm1Hubj9koM219hbr2l-8BFYM4x1UqZ07p5EQcmPevrefz6R3EvqnPSxqcjhfcX68rt_tJdTbMRmwWrDBrBzq_TeZ5purV5U7bgZPkPaL5eMFM0LJNvVs866p6zcw4KCFrx75OiC_tfRDv1I4DlhHnHYIaEvjlwdfWJss6aMGmQgmf6fLrn8gVIaV13bNbA5DYLGUjszf5MDLBQIDm81Xnz9Pb-xcQ2f_BHBis5McaJM5k6e8OC9VAmZNdracsXfAB04PIIRjAlzyW7G0xn_7rT13nsdizeKZOKDPjsLt_qU1yG73WhHE2WZBSKjfc9TUSIeGaF9eCAj5NFUvbgvrHUrZV0N907oFxxiHtLLNzn6NhmxC7yFBJZk-EcPpfg58b2jAvBugMcXrCWahuDWjo1BDIeanfDRkPBAziOK2pr2goNXU1sD5wU-dbQm4MT4sAsN1QBi-Ufsy_qmK91Ncw5ChcLpVcavBihdAAGyg%3D%3D)

**In short, my son, Nicholas, was tragically stabbed to death and murdered in 2016.**

If you’re a parent, I’m sure you could imagine how devastating this was for me. Nicholas was only 28 at the time and did not deserve what happened.

He had followed in my footsteps and joined the Marine Corps. He was a father to two children – my grandchildren. When it happened, no one came forward with any information, and the case to find the killer went cold.

**I decided to take a stand, to fight for the rule of law and public safety so that no other family has to experience the same tragedy.** Five years later, I ran for City Council in Hemet. I won, and just a few months later, our amazing law enforcement found the killer and arrested him.

**WHAT ARE MY PRIORITIES AS YOUR NEXT CONGRESSMAN?** [](http://links.joemalesforca.com/u/click?_t=87a0bf2fd7e446429f4e355f2cd52f45&_m=7eb3520fc4e24ac1a20b4c3861be3182&_e=rZ03XUXdoFCKRTUv3kST4W_qTw-HMZghewaktoQBSjeLLHm1Hubj9koM219hbr2l-8BFYM4x1UqZ07p5EQcmPevrefz6R3EvqnPSxqcjhfcX68rt_tJdTbMRmwWrDBrBzq_TeZ5purV5U7bgZPkPaL5eMFM0LJNvVs866p6zcw5yOOz9SS0Xr9skUjnuFrlMkdb04HUme9YKa5i5EOjInL3Ih-9CdHyuTXCb7k8aFjvbun1yKbMGjC5YPNjdns6PDgT5al50tpbag2DG5M_wWurbsqxzZYx652jLv2m0zK-i3avDfRgCHFQWgatB7lM9dbmixmH-zZfRsci_dxUiH5E1LjH_yW2mpLTI_rOEdDaUir6co1CvQiHzQH8QjKWv923voGQhey10NLNxzZkIrK2nMMYE6cBMk2643lJyHodTnQS923pq72zZQF98MXB7EeAqYwneJ6tKwZej2SqqQsP026FlBlijp3Tnu5VcVgDNey77zG3mTDjFKn7J6YORcwQXgKQxRBQssgnIGx6beg%3D%3D)

_**As a former Democrat turned Republican, I know what the Democrat Party is supposed to represent. But ever since the Reagan era, they’ve continued to move farther and farther to the extreme left. Now, they stand for DEI, wokeness, putting Americans last, and doing everything they can to fight against President Trump.**_

**As a Hispanic American who lives in a border district and who was adopted by American parents, I fully believe in LEGAL immigration.** America is THE BEST COUNTRY IN THE WORLD! Millions of people around the world want to move here for the American Dream, for the opportunity of a better life, but they must do it THE RIGHT WAY.

**Our Southern Border has been porous under Joe Biden’s Administration.** Living in a border district, I’ve seen firsthand millions of illegal immigrants entering the country with the help of the dangerous Mexican Cartel, many through my hometown, bringing dangerous drugs like fentanyl, trafficking women and children, and committing heinous crimes on our side of the border. This needs to END, and I’m grateful for President Trump’s leadership on this. In Congress, I’ll always defend strong border security.

**On top of that, I am a firm believer in the America-First Movement.** After four years under Joe Biden’s leadership, America has become weak in every aspect. I already mentioned our border security, but our military, social life, and economy have all become weakened under the rule of DEI and wokeness.

**As a military veteran, it pained me to see the way Joe Biden withdrew from Afghanistan, giving the Taliban millions of dollars worth of high-level American military equipment, which they parade around.** Our weakened military presence allowed Russia to invade Ukraine and Hamas to launch terrorist attacks on Israel. subject: I’ll bet you’re surprised to get this message from me
body:

---
